explanation: Venus spins backwards compared with most planets, and very slowly. One full day there, from sunrise to sunrise, lasts about 117 Earth days.

claims.text: Because Venus rotates in the opposite direction to its orbit, the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east there.
Venus rotates in the opposite direction to Earth and almost every other planet.
A solar day on Venus, from sunrise to sunrise, lasts about 117 Earth days.
